Why I look for Perfection ?

When I was a kid I believe I got good Sense of Humour..ahm may be it still alive inside me .. well now who cares!! when wheel chair is only thing around you

But what I wanna say is when u got good humour you think you can troll anyone and well yea.. you troll everyone and there is some kinda a saitan keep growing inside u .. (call it animal)

See, like if some guy is walking oddly or girl with heavy voice or odd smile or any kinda fault that actually is not a fault but we troll them and sometime we forget our limit too.. we got addicted too even. Some kinda adrenaline rushed inside us (nourishing animal inside us..)

Slowly slowly that time gone when we were in higher education.. I lost lot of friends got too many new faces too but now next chapter going to start in my life i.e. marrying a girl. I got lot of girlfriend over time but I feels like their is some kinda defect on them cuz my brain is too hungry to find pin in a chunk of bush so that I use them to troll or may be animal is too wild now to eat the imperfection and pin to my thoughts 💭

Well it hurts sometimes that our all fun leads us to a bad habit we adopt overtime

The point is
When we were trolling we were actually judging people and that lead us to find perfection in people in our society that leads to bad mindset of not getting trolled and finding a PERFECT MATCH!!. which is impossible.

Scientifically if I accept imperfection of someone then she/he would be perfect for me!

Well what I wanna say is ..trolling joking or building a dark humour should be totally seperated from your thought about the real world…question is how? So answer is ‘think about yourself ‘ give yourself a time to know that your brain is in your control…

I mean presence of mind .

I mean writing your chapter of life by own

Don’t fuck up the joke with reality… people don’t generally think like that I know but you can’t stop doing fun with friends and trolling other is real fun I guess …lol

You should know how to control your thought process…don’t worry but remember Nothing and nobody is perfect…if something is perfect then it might be 👾 alien

Good night
